end.parentNote: Asha practised making estimates by using known groups and checking whether the estimate was close to the actual number. Ananya used 40 for 43 and 30 for 32, and later explained that an estimate is a close guess rather than an exact count. They mixed up spread-out objects with having more, and this was not corrected later in the lesson. At home, show a small group of objects, make a group-based estimate together, then count to check how close it was.
